instruction: Repair ONE local staircase geometry defect. In image 1, the lowest stair at local y~575..765 wrongly stops at x~285 while all higher stairs reach x~505, the plain upright parapet's left edge. EXTEND only this lowest tread and its dark vertical front riser to the RIGHT so it ends at x~505, aligned exactly with the stair widths immediately above. Continue its existing horizontal front edge and white bevel with the same height, perspective and shadow. Move the tiny red paper that was in the newly occupied area onto the tread at the same x/y screen position if visible. Keep the plain broad upright parapet unchanged; do not turn it into an ornament or add a ledge. All other steps, scattered red paper, floor joints, lighting, camera and existing stone texture stay unchanged. The extension affects approximately x285..505 and y575..765 only, with natural contact at the existing parapet.
